notes: The *who is* of t009–t010 goes to the expressed predicate noun δυνάστης under rule 92, the article keeping only its own *the*.

The two participial genitives are compressed into bare nouns, so their articles have no determiner to anchor and are `unrepresented` under rule 23; rule 90's single-word case does not reach them, the one English word being the participle's own lexical realization.
ἰδίοις is anarthrous here and carries *its own* under rule 47 with no article competing.
